{{Top|leg}}
The '''Beastlord''' was a quasi-mythical entity among the [[A'Mar]], [[Human/Legends|Human]] inhabitants of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Lamus]]. It was said to be the "the mightiest of [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]]," and as a coming-of-age ritual, young A'Mar, both [[Gender/Legends|male]] and female, went on a [[Beastlord's Hunt]] to try and find it.
